method.clock: global action ledger; room clock pauses off-floor

preprocessing.input: RGB uint8 HWC -> BGR for ultralytics

method.floor_change_decision: RPT* over rooms and stair nodes; a staircase is charged its flight plus 8.0 m on every arc; no allowance, no clock; the explicit floor_decision rule is the exploration fallback's last resort
method.floor_exit_gate: none: a floor change is the RPT* order's or the fallback rule's to take at any time

glances.rule: at most one in-place glance per route, where along the route a left, right or full look reveals the most unknown floor the walk itself will not, if that clears the gain and gain-per-action floors; a suspended phase (no loop charge, clocks paused); a confident detection cut off by the frame's edge is a cue to turn toward it

node_oracle.asks: independent P(searching there finds target), without a fixed action horizon; the model is briefed with the HOUSE line (room types found, rooms unidentified, openings unlooked, actions used of the budget) and writes home/house/stage and a first|second pass verdict before the numbers (LLM-first, 2026-10-07)
node_oracle.cadence: loop points and semantic discovery; unchanged prompts reused
node_oracle.nodes: every room of the floor in force (finished and type-excluded ones shown with their status) + its staircases + its openings

method.openings: doorways and gaps at the edge of the mapped floor are nodes beside the rooms and the stairs, visited by a peek (threshold, face the unknown, one look to each side) priced at 4 actions; valued by the oracle (uncertainty floor off, elsewhere value off, home floor off); a confirmed landmark of the target's class is a node at p=0.85 without an oracle call, visited by the same peek from 1.5 m
method.reasoning_cadence: room LLM at loop points and semantic discovery events; geometry every 1 action(s); synchronous frame processing, one full rotation (warm-up scan) before room selection on every storey first entered
method.room_partition: watershed of observed free space with seen stair footprints excluded; stairs are never a room; a detected door's cut is snapped to the nearest choke within 0.9 m; furniture is credited to the nearest room floor; room numbers are unique across the building
method.room_visit: frontier walk: the room's frontier that reveals the most unknown floor per metre walked, then the next, until none is left (bounded by 60 actions); a room the agent stood in with no live frontier is finished (explored), and so is a room a full rotation stood in or saw more than half of, one with no live frontier the camera looked into or walked through, or a doorless fragment under 3.0 m2; every rotation is as many turns as the camera's field of view needs to see the circle; openings off a room that is itself a node are folded into its walk; finished rooms are shown to the oracle with their status and offered again (DISABLED: second_pass off) once its pass verdict says the home is covered (a revisit scans from a spot at least 1.5 m from the earlier scan points); rooms whose STRONG type label cannot hold the target are valued by the oracle like every other room (type_prior off); one signature object (a bed, a toilet, an oven) makes a label strong

segmentation.depth: robust_mask_depth over the mask within the box; near-surface component, no coherence gate
segmentation.scope: target boxes at or above detection_confidence

preprocessing.input: RGB uint8 HWC -> BGR for ultralytics
preprocessing.masks: boolean, original frame resolution, one per box in box order

sight.rule: unknown looked through from 2 poses within 2.5 m without a depth return, and enclosed unknown pockets under 3.0 m2 that nothing could stand in (inscribed width under 0.6 m, or stood on by the agent), are settled: not frontier, not openings, not glance gain; the planner and the display keep the real map
